scope: EMA ONLY — the RVOL family is specified separately and is not referenced here as a default, a fallback or an assumption

split_from.why: EMA and RVOL are independently specifiable families; RVOL's nine undeclared parameters are no reason to stall a family whose binding decisions are all made

one_minute_role.invariant: the FEATURE / CLOCK DICTIONARY must name, for every 1m-derived quantity, the coarser-TF definition it measures. A 1m quantity with no coarse-TF parent is inadmissible by construction.
one_minute_role.satisfied_by: EMA is defined on the registered coarse parents 15m/1H/1D, which exist as production data; 1m may only time when a coarse state became observable

rationale_without_reference_to_Y: the compact EMA family already used in prior coarse-timeframe T/Z logic
preserves continuity with prior programme logic
avoids expanding into additional legacy EMA families
registry.explicitly_not_because: frequency of occurrence in the legacy codebase
registry.post_Y_expansion: forbidden without a new registered search family, its own multiplicity treatment, and fresh/forward confirmation

timeframe_registry.note: availability differences between timeframes are REPORTED, never optimised away by choosing different periods per timeframe

contamination_tolerance.rule: a coarse interval containing any required UNOBSERVED constituent minute is not EMA input

segmentation.segment: a contiguous run of COMPLETE coarse bars
segmentation.after_break: the next COMPLETE bar begins a NEW segment
forbidden: carrying pre-gap EMA state into the new segment
segmentation.overnight: a normal transition between eligible sessions does NOT itself break a segment

formula.seed: EMA_1 = close_1 at the first COMPLETE bar of a new segment
formula.recurrence: EMA_t = alpha * close_t + (1 - alpha) * EMA_(t-1), within the same valid segment only

warm_up_validity.example: EMA200 requires 200 consecutive COMPLETE coarse bars before becoming VALID

causal_availability.rule: EMA[t] inherits the information-availability timestamp of its input coarse bar t
causal_availability.consequence: EMA on a 15m bar is unavailable before that 15m bar completes; 1H and 1D behave analogously
causal_availability.backward_projection_forbidden: a completed coarse value may not be projected back into its constituent 1m minutes
causal_availability.as_a_clock: the earliest eligible 1m timestamp is at or after the frozen coarse information-availability timestamp

no_derived_search_features.permitted: the 12 EMA series plus validity metadata
no_derived_search_features.why: feature production must not silently become search-space construction

feature_validity_vs_cohort.rule: a security remains one of the frozen 476 even when EMA is UNAVAILABLE or INITIALIZATION_SENSITIVE
feature_validity_vs_cohort.forbidden: constructing a cleaner security cohort from feature availability

availability_expectation.binding: these justify transparent availability accounting; they do NOT change the registry

ema200_retained.decision: EMA200 stays although only 72 of 476 securities have any 200-bar COMPLETE daily run
ema200_retained.why: that is an AVAILABILITY problem, not a parameter-selection problem. Dropping it would let X-side capability reshape the hypothesis family.
ema200_retained.instead: definition fixed; VALID where age >= 200, UNAVAILABLE elsewhere; availability reported exactly
ema200_retained.also_forbidden: loosening contamination semantics to raise its availability

auction_semantics.close_boundary_bar: SESSION_CLOSE_BOUNDARY_BAR remains neutral; the auction reading is recorded upstream as plausible and undemonstrated
auction_semantics.effect_on_ema: none — the close-boundary bar is not an EMA input under any circumstance
auction_semantics.recorded_because: the RVOL dictionary must work on what is actually known rather than on a presumed attribution

required: a contaminated coarse bar cannot enter EMA
a contaminated gap breaks the EMA segment
pre-gap EMA state cannot survive the break
EMA cannot be forward-filled across an unavailable interval
EMA cannot become VALID before age >= period
a future coarse close cannot affect EMA[t]
a coarse EMA cannot become visible before coarse bar completion
extended-hours / close-boundary / WHEN_ISSUED / NOT_YET / supplemental inputs cannot affect EMA
feature invalidity cannot remove a security from the frozen cohort
a legacy ribbon period outside the registry cannot enter production
negative_fixtures.standard: each must show the dangerous version FAILS and the correct version PASSES

per_stream: share of coarse observations with VALID EMA

rvol_branch.leak_scan: the sealed payload is walked before writing and the build refuses if any parameter-shaped key (rvol / lookback / baseline / threshold / per-slot / sample_count) carries a numeric value outside the rvol_branch and mutations subtrees
rvol_branch.leak_scan_targets: a parameter DEFAULT, not the word RVOL — a first version matched raw text and flagged this artifact's own sentence saying RVOL is specified separately

next_step: EMA feature smoke + label-free capability, then EMA production. RVOL remains on its own branch and is not started.
